notes.title: 1.6 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! 
A new update is out now, featuring a few [b]changes and additions to both Campaign and Ascension mode[/b] to make things a bit smoother in terms of progression!

[h1]Challenges[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 10 Challenge Battles in the Equinox Cathedral.
[/list]
[i]Challenges are a new addition in the Campaign mode.
[b]You can access the Challenge section of the Equinox Cathedral after clearing Naraka.[/b]
Here you can play a series of one-time battles of different variety and difficulty that will reward you with[b] Bones, Dark Bones and Orbs[/b]!
These battles come with their own small gimmicks and quirks, so sometimes you will have to experiment to find how to approach them the best way.
[b]A new set of challenges will unlock after defeating the final boss of Naraka, Temple of Koa and Scorched Bastion - but you can tackle them at any time![/b]
[/i]
[h1]Ascension[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased the initial number of Bones and Dark Bones at the start of every cycle after the first one.

[i]We have increased the resources you start with for Ascension cycles after the first one.
This will allow you to start with multiple passives and stat boosts, as well as items and potions, as the difficulty of Ascension gets higher.[/i]

[*]Decreased HP of several Elite Enemies

[i]A lot of Elite Enemies felt too tanky with long fights that would deplete your resources. 
We have generally decreased their HP.[/i]
[/list]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Spanish language!
[*]Added 10 new achievements
[*]Improved “Empowered” effect: after consuming a Deity level, Andora will always gain back a gem depending on the Empowered card that was played
[*]Fixed an interaction between Ishana and certain trinkets that could cause a bug
[/list]


[b]As always - we look forward to your feedback![/b]

Thank you and have fun!

[i]SH TEAM[/i]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE & OCTOBER UPDATE: SECRET BOSS
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

Today we can finally announce that [b]Shattered Heaven is leaving Early Access on NOVEMEBR 8TH[/b]!
The full release will include the [b]Campaign, Ascension Mode, new languages & a few improvements and balance tweaks we will release on patch day[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/b4c103dcda4f4d30b19e1f0946e8f037500324fe.png[/img]
We will release more content and patches in the months after release - and we will continue evaluating and working on your feedback!

[h1]TODAY'S UPDATE: VERSION 1.4.0[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/c7e4ad4c34c9c82eeced611adda3c0d42e5c6317.png[/img]
Today's update introduces [b]a few tweaks to Ascension Mode including a big quality of life regarding smelting cards.[/b]
But - most importantly - [b]we are introducing a new, secret boss![/b]
[i]This boss was designed as a collaboration of one of our most important supporters during our Kickstarter campaign - thank you Scott![/i]

To unlock this boss, you will need to delve deep into Ascension and unlock the advanced cycles... and find out how to unlock this new challenge yourself!

[h1]BALANCE & FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added[b] 3 free Smelt at the start of every dungeon after Naraka in Ascension Mode[/b].
[i]We realized that the amount of Neutral cards you could get in Ascension Mode could be too overwhelming. 
For this reason, everytime you enter a new dungeon after the first one (Naraka), you will be offered 3 free smelt to use as you see fit.[/i]
[*] Added Cycle 6 (Ascension)
[*] Fixed a few bugs regardings events in Ascension Mode
[*] Fixed a few typos and localization errors
[*] Fixed a bug with certain achievements not triggering in New Game +
[*] Added new Achievements tied to Ascension
[/list]

As always, we look forward to your feedback -  especially now in this last month of Early Access!
We thank you for your support during these last months and we can't wait for the full release!

notes.title: AUGUST UPDATE V 1.3: ASCENSION MODE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
ASCENSION MODE (Alpha) is out today!

This will be the first iteration of our new game mode, [u][b]and we plan to tune it regularly in the upcoming months.[/b][/u]

[h1]ASCENSION MODE & PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/39986a39ddb423eae41615fb6d07e2e0e5a8cbd6.png[/img]
ASCENSION is available immediately to everyone.
[b]We advise you to play the tutorial and try out the campaign mode first.[/b]
[i]Note: Ascension contains spoilers for the campaign mode bosses.[/i]
[list]
[*][b] Added the first 5 Cycles of Ascension[/b] - Bosses will change and new event, trinkets, relics and cards will unlock up to the 5th cycle.
[*]Added [b]old and new passives for Andora, Magni and Ishana in the Dark Forge[/b] (Ascension) Shop.
[*]Added [b]3 new BOSSES[/b] for Naraka, Temple of Koa and Scorched Bastion (Ascension).
[*]Added [b]several new ELITE encounters[/b] (Ascension).
[*]Added [b]50 RELICS[/b] to be obtained in Ascension mode.
[i]Relics are powerful items that will grant your party passives for the rest of the run![/i]
[*]All[b] Events outcomes in Ascension have been changed[/b] to better fit the Game Mode.
[*] [b]Traps have been reworked for Ascension[/b] - granting powerful bonuses if you manage to overcome them!
[/list]
[h1]BUFIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs
[*]Fixed minor typos
[/list]
We look forward to hear your opinion on the new game mode!
[u][b]As stated before, this is the very first iteration of Ascension: your feedback is incredibly valuable for us to improve balance and user-friendliness. [/b][/u]

Be sure to leave your feedback on the discussion tab or join our DISCORD!

[b]We hope you will have fun with ASCENSION![/b]

notes.title: JULY UPDATE: NEW GAME +
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!
A new patch containing the NEW GAME + mode is releasing today!

[h1]NEW GAME +[/h1]

NEW GAME + will be available to you after completing the main campaign, and it will not be directly tied to your standard campaign game saves.
Save files will show with a red logo in the load and save menu,

[b]NEW GAME + FEATURES:[/b]

[list]
[*] 3 New HERO CARDS per character added:
[list]
[*] 3 new Common Hero cards are unlocked after defeating Sigurd.
[*] 3 new Rare Hero cards are unlocked after defeating Eris.
[*] 3 new Legendary cards are unlocked after defeating Achala.
[/list]
[*] 3 New ELITE ENEMIES have been added to Naraka Depth 3, Temple of Koa Depth 3 and Scorched Bastion Depth 3.
[*] 14 New NEUTRAL CARDS have been added in the draft pool of every dungeon.
[*] All Hero Cards from NEW GAME are unlocked from the start of NEW GAME +.
[*] Added the Vestal + and Everchosen + difficulties.
[*] Neutral Cards draft follow now an unlimited format (ie: every Neutral Card can appear in every Dungeon)
[*] New enemy parties configurations.
[*] Initial Bones and Dark Bones increased.
[*] Skill points rewards are doubled.
[*] Dark Bones and Stat Orbs rewards are increased
[/list]

[h1]MISC CHANGES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed several minor bugs
[*] Fixed several typos
[*] Enabled Steam Cloud
[*] Fixed Skin unlocking being disabled after a recent patch
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES : V 1.1.1 + NEW CARDS SNEAK PEEK
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Today we have a small but significant update that aims[b] to improve the feeling of Neutral Cards[/b].
As always, this is only a step towards more balance to come!

But first, let me introduce you to [b]3 of the new Neutral Cards you will find in NEW GAME +[/b], coming out this July!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/126c66dcbe1b7ae7c9a4c192ba810c42becb3187.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more cards previews coming soon!

[h1]PATCH NOTES (V.1.1.1) :[/h1]

[h3]Neutral Cards:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rules of Nature => Extra damage from playing other Neutral Cards has been increased from 2 to 4.
[*] Charming Denial => Base Armor increased by 1.
[*] True Sight => Removed Armor gain. This card now removes a debuff.
[*] Shadow of Doubt => Base Damage increased by 2.
[*] Mind over Matter => Removed Armor gain. ENLIGHTENMENT increased from 1 to 2.
[*] Fire Walk with Me => Base Damage increased by 3.
[*] Growing Ambitions => Base Armor and Healing increased by 1.
[*] Fangs of Delham => Base Damage increased by 2.
[*] Just cause => Base Damage increased by 1. Rage gained by Magni increased by 2.
[*] Martial prowess => SWIFT and GOUGE increased from 1 to 2. Reworked Magni's effect: "Draw a card with the BERSERK keyword from the deck".
[*] Colour of the Wind => Removed Armor gain. Reduced AP cost from 1 to 0.
[*] Apostasy => Added debuff STRIPPING on target enemy.
[*] Broken Vow => Base Damage increased by 1.
[*] Love eternal => Base Damage increased by 2.
[*] Leave a Trace => Base Armor increased by 3.
[*] Sic Parvis Magna => Base Damage increased by 2.
[*] Crusade of Fate => Base Healing increased by 2.
[*] Epiphany of Creation => Reduced AP cost from 2 to 1.
[/list]

[h3]Other changes & Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a list of cards played during a turn in the deck tab.
[*] Hp and Armor of Temple of Koa's Warden (Stage 3) have been nerfed slightly.
[*] Bosses of Temple of Koa and Scorched Bastion have been slightly rebalanced with more Hp and more damage on certain underperforming moves.
[*] Temple of Koa Depth 1-2 has been changed to improve diversity of encounters.
[*] Scorched Bastion Depth 1 and Depth 2 have been changed to include more encounter with 2 enemies parties.
[*] Fixed a bug involved skill points and loading old templates in the full game and demo version.
[*] Fixed a soft lock in the tutorial when the player closes the game in the first draft in the full game and the demo version.
[*] Fixed a bug with the achievement "Conqueror of Ashram" not unlocking correctly.
[*] Fixed the description of the trinket "Coat of pride".
[*] Fixed a few missions appearing on the wrong ecounters.
[*] Fixed a new bug with the skill Whirlwind of blades
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES: V1.1.0 + DEMO UPDATES
notes.notes:
[h1]New: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the [b]options to check the party’s decks during drafts[/b].
[*]Added a[b] healing powder counter[/b] next to the characters’ portrait while resting at the altar.
[/list]
[h1]Game balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Removed the mandatory drafts at the start of every floor of every dungeon[/b] (excluding the final boss).
[i]This is a first balance change we are making towards making Neutral Cards drafts less oppressive.
Now drafts will only be found after battles, certain events and, optionally, at the altar.
Our next step will involve balancing Neutral Cards to make them more appealing.[/i]
[*] - EVERCHOSEN difficulty: [b]reduced the damage of enemies[/b].
[i]This is a preliminary change we are making while working on a better scaling for the Everchosen difficulty.[/i]
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug involving skill and deck templates, causing the game to run slowly over time.
[*] Fixed a bug that would occasionally remove skill points when loading a template.
[*] Fixed a bug related to Kairos’ options during the merchant event.
[*] Fixed a bug with the skill Coup de Grace.
[*] Fixed a bug with the skill Whirlwind of blades.
[*] Fixed several dialogues that will not take into account certain player choices in chapter 2 and 3.
[*] Fixed a rare bug related to battles with specific conditions.
[*] Fixed the spawn of the enemy “Parasite” when reloading a fight in Everchosen difficulty.
[*] Fixed a bug with certain craftable potions in the alchemy lab.
[*] Fixed some typos. 
[/list]
[h1]Demo version:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the demo version to match the current version of the game[u]: save files from the new demo update are now compatible with the full game, added chinese language[/u].
[/list]

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
To all the warriors out there.

After some weeks of reasonings, we've taken the tough decision to further postpone the release date of Shattered Heaven to the [b]31th of May[/b].
Our desire is to immediately offer a complete experience so that all the features that make Shattered Heaven so special will be fully appreciated. We are working hard to give to our creature the shape we've imagined since the beginning of this journey. 
In the meantime, we invite you to follow all the in-depth updates about the game coming on our shop page.
Apologies for the delay, we trust in your understanding.

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve made the hard decision to postpone the release date of Shattered Heaven by 3 weeks.
The new release date is now set for April 19th.
We are working hard to deliver a rich and satisfying experience, with all the features that make Shattered Heaven polished and balanced at their best. Apologies for the delay, we trust in your understading. More updates about the game are coming soon, stay tuned!
